decisions.reason: Inertial measurement sensor module closely fits the established sensor portfolio and shows no signals of underperformance.
Industrial AC voltage input module has a dedicated page and aligns with core automation and energy measurement.
Four-channel solid state relay module is complementary to established power control products and remains a useful module.
RGB LED control module is peripheral to the firm's core sensing, control, and charging direction and lacks a dedicated page.
Remote access service for wallboxes supports the strategic expansion into charging and energy management.
